Name: Strawberry Cows
Author: AngoraDuchess
Description:
Wish you could have more cute, pink cows in your life? This mod adds Strawberry cows to Stardew Valley 1.6!

Strawberry cows live in big barns and can be purchased from Marnie for 6000g. They will grow up in 6 days, after which they produce strawberry milk which
can be turned into strawberry cheese in the cheese press. Strawberry cows follow the same rules as vanilla cows, meaning after reaching high enough friendship they'll produce larger strawberry milks too.
Strawberry milk and cheese are worth more and restore more health/energy than their vanilla milk producing counterparts, more than even goats.

Included in the files are three versions: the main recommended one is meant to fit in with vanilla textures, the others under the "Miscellaneous Files" header are meant to fit in with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67968777]siamece[/url] that I personally use, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20044]Elle's Cuter Barn Animals[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/39003995]junimods[/url]. They are all the [b]same[/b], minus the assets, so choose the one that fits your style!

Feel free to suggest the cow texture packs you personally use if you'd like me to add a "compatibility" between it and strawberry cows.
If you have ideas for other types of cows, let me know them and if I like your idea I'll see about adding them in a future mod. :D


In-Progress features:
- Ability to age strawberry cheese in casks
- Cuter Fatter Cows version
